verdict.rationale: Sumsub's docs explicitly describe liveness detection that confirms the applicant is a real, live person and not a deepfake, AI-generated image, paper mask, or photo of a screen, and matches them to the account/document on file, plus a review workflow for liveness results and a broader Liveness & Face match check within verification levels. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of anti-spoofing efficacy (e.g., third-party pentest or lab results) and explicit mention of replayed-video defenses beyond screen-photo detection.
